regime_context: US theme ranks show a concentrated semiconductor/AI leadership stack with Memory-HBM & Storage (SMH proxy, crowded, trend tag) on top, but the rotation view is 'narrowing' (41% eligible) and non-directional, with absorption low at 0.31 and no single dominant narrative. The validated edge here is the absolute-trend gate for drawdown control, not any rank ordering; given shared SMH proxies across multiple top themes, I keep conviction low and avoid layering correlated leans.
emerging_watch: Watch whether AI Infrastructure (rank 2, eligible, mixed-trend) closes the 0.417 score gap to Memory, HBM & Storage (leader) on rising breadth above 0.125 — a sustained narrowing of that margin would flag a potential leadership handoff within the crowded semiconductor complex, not yet confirmed.

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity is the highest-ranked eligible theme that is NOT on the shared SMH semiconductor proxy, giving it a cleaner standalone read. It is trend-tagged and eligible, with the strongest breadth of the eligible leaders (0.5), suggesting cohesion rather than a single-name spike. The absolute-trend gate (the one validated leg) supports staying power.
theses.dissent: CIBR is crowded (z=1.93, highest crowding flag in the top names), and crowding is a size-down caution; high crowding with a trend tag can mark exhaustion rather than continuation.

falsifier.text: CIBR loses its absolute-trend eligibility (falls below its durability bar of 0.68) before the 20-day check-by date.

theses.subject: US Energy Complex
theses.thesis: Energy is one of the few eligible non-tech, non-semiconductor themes with a trend tag and modest (not crowded) positioning. It offers diversification away from the crowded semiconductor stack while still clearing the validated absolute-trend gate.
theses.dissent: Breadth is extremely thin (0.045), meaning the trend is carried by very few names and is fragile to a single-stock reversal.

falsifier.text: XLE breadth drops to 0.0 and the theme loses eligible status before the 20-day check-by date.
